name: What should I do immediately after my home sustains storm damage?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after my home sustains storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately after storm damage, prioritize safety by checking for hazards like downed power lines or structural instability. Take temporary measures to prevent further damage, such as covering a broken window or placing a tarp over a leaking roof. Document everything by taking clear photos and videos of the damage before any temporary repairs. Then, contact your insurance company to report the damage and reach out to a trusted repair professional like Maine Results, Inc. for a detailed assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize safety, prevent further damage with temporary fixes, document everything, then contact your insurer and a repair professional.
